newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish strike action falls 13.51 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Spanish strike action falls 13.51 pct in 1996.

text.p: The number of strikes affecting Spain's labour market in 1996 dipped to the lowest level in the previous six years, the Labour Ministry said on Sunday.
Last year 466,673 workers participated in 749 strikes with 1.14 million working days lost. This compares to 866 strikes in 1995 with 569,906 participants and 1.44 million days lost.
It represents a 20.83 percent reduction in the number of days lost to labour action and a fall in the the percentage of participation to 40.44 percent from 41.82 percent in 1995.
"The rate of labour disputes in 1996 was the lowest in the 1990-1996 period," the ministry said in a statement.

Collective bargaining talks, traditionally the principal motivator for strike action, accounted for 208 of the total number of strikes in 1996, a 14.05 percent reduction from 1995, and 51.31 percent of the total number of days lost.
